description: Undo one bulk act on a sprint — a set from list_sprint_changes, or the 'changeId' delete_sprint, complete_sprint and set_issues_sprint answered. Only what nobody has changed since goes back: an issue whose sprint is still what the act left returns where it was; a deleted sprint comes back from the trash with the issues still in the backlog; a completed sprint opens again (as 'future' when another sprint of the board is active now — 'stateChanged') with the issues it sent away. Anything changed since is a CONFLICT — 'conflicts' names each with 'reason' (moved, with 'now' where it lies; gone; forbidden; paused; scope; sprint_gone) and 'conflictsHidden' counts those of projects you cannot open. With mode='all' (the default) nothing is written while there is a conflict (reason conflicts, the plan in the answer); with mode='free' what is free goes back and the conflicts stay. apply=false answers what it would do and changes nothing. A set is undone once; the undo is a line in the project's journal and every issue moved a line in its history, in your name. Needs the right the act needed: the board's sprints for a delete or a completion (member, admin or lead), write in each issue's project for a move.

apply.description: false answers what it would do and changes nothing. Default true.

changeId.description: The set's id — 'id' from list_sprint_changes, or 'changeId' from the act.

mode.description: 'all' (the default): nothing while anything changed since. 'free': what is free, the rest named.

name: rollback_sprint_change
title: Rollback sprint change
